title: TWAS Research Professors in LDCs
about: TWAS appoints Research Professors for one year to visit host institutions in Least Developed Countries for two to four weeks. Host research groups submit requests; invitees are TWAS Members, Young Affiliates and Alumni with a PhD in the natural sciences. Deadline: 23 November 2026.
requirements: Invitees are TWAS Members, Young Affiliates and Alumni
Minimum degree: PhD, in the natural sciences; no age limit
Requests come from research groups and scientific institutions in Least Developed Countries
Applicants may apply for only one programme per calendar year in the TWAS and OWSD portfolio

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Requests come from research groups and scientific institutions in Least Developed Countries" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Minimum degree: PhD, in the natural sciences" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
